findings.text: red-team lens, high: `--from-stage <cycle>` with pre-existing `cycle_iterations[cycle].current_iter > 0` causes the cycle to start at the persisted iteration rather than iter=1, because `_ZBUILD_RESUME_ACTIVE=true` is exported for every resume path including `--from-stage`, and the orchestrator unconditionally reads `current_iter` whenever the flag is true; DSFSTG-1 says `stage.start` is emitted for "<s>'s first cycle member" (implying iter=1 member=0); the from-stage test fixture writes no `cycle_iterations` key, so `_persisted_iter` defaults to 0 and the bug is never triggered. (core/pipeline/cycle-orchestrator.sh:2396; fix: code)

red-team lens, medium: The DSCMBR-1 'skip complete member' path in `_cycle_iter_dispatch` does not verify the skipped member's primary artifact is present before emitting `stage.start` for the subsequent interrupted member; DSRHYD-2 requires exit 1 before any `stage.start` when a complete stage's artifact is absent after rehydration, but `stage.start` for the interrupted member (line 1489) fires without first checking whether each already-skipped member's artifact is on disk. (core/pipeline/cycle-orchestrator.sh:1468; fix: code)

red-team lens, medium: TOCTOU in the auto-resume `latest`-symlink block: `get_resume_recommendation("$state_dir/latest/pipeline-state.json")` is called at line 2242 before the symlink target is validated against the state root; the escape check only runs inside the `auto_resume` branch at line 2256; an attacker who can write to the state directory and atomically replace `latest` between the `[[ -L ... ]]` test and the `readlink -f` call can cause `get_resume_recommendation` to read from a file outside the state root before the escape check fires. (core/pipeline/runner.sh:2242; fix: code)
